conviction_note: The findings sum to +0.7: guidance arithmetic that leaves room to narrow the same-restaurant-sales (SRS) range upward, Chipotle's late-August recovery, and buyback/insider support. Margin pressure and the salad-category hit pull the other way. The scaled number is near zero (p_up 51 x abs 12) because a +17% five-day run-up and a +16.5-point put skew already price a recovery. The gap between the two numbers is the run-up and the skew, which I count in p_up rather than in each finding.
bar: Q3 FY26 (12 weeks to about early October) consensus: EPS $0.12 and revenue about $357.4-358.4m (Earnings Whispers https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/CAVA/21799 ; Cerbat Gem/MarketBeat https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/10/28/cava-group-cava-expected-to-announce-quarterly-earnings-on-wednesday.html ; Chartmill shows $366.8m, an outlier). SRS consensus about 3-3.6% from one source only (Investing.com, 2026-11-04, https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/cava-earnings-on-deck-growth-test-amid-fast-casual-headwinds-93CH-5000733). The year-ago comparison is 1.9% SRS on flat traffic. Company FY26 guide, reaffirmed 2026-08-11: SRS 4.5-6.5%, adjusted EBITDA $181-191m, restaurant-level margin 23.7-24.3%, 75-77 net new openings (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001639438/000162828026055709/earningsrelease2026q2.htm). EPS and revenue are sourced from two agreeing sources; the SRS bar is single-source, so findings that depend on it are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 15.85m shares, 4.0 days to cover, as of 2026-09-30 (massive.com, https://massive.com/quote/cava). Other undated snapshots show 11.8-13.4% of float, 3.2-4.3 days to cover (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/CAVA/statistics/). That is moderate, not crowded. Baseline: 25-delta skew +16.5 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.95, event-implied move 12.1% (ATM spread 37% of mid, indicative only). The stock is +17.3% over 5 days and +22.2% over 20 days into the print, but still -34.7% from its 52-week high. The stock was up about 5.4% on the print day in a broad rally (Dow +2.9%, WTI -7.9%, per the Investing.com page). Earnings Whispers puts bearish readings at 17.5%, up from 10%.

findings.finding: The FY26 SRS guide leaves room to narrow upward. H1 SRS was 9.7% (Q1, 16 weeks) and 9.0% (Q2, 12 weeks), about 9.4% over 28 of 52 weeks. With Q3 at the ~3.3% consensus, the 4.5-6.5% guide implies Q4 SRS of about -1.4% at the midpoint and about -5.7% at the low end, against an easy Q4-2025 lap of +0.5%. Any Q4 at or above zero puts FY at about 5.9-6.8%, the upper half of the range. The CFO said the low end means slightly negative H2 SRS and that nothing in trends pointed there.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2026: a guide raise (SRS 3-5% to 4.5-6.5%) on a 9.7% SRS beat bought +3.08% close to close (baseline 2026-05-19). Feb 2026: the first 2026 guide with trends tracking above it bought +26.4%. Aug 2026: a reaffirmed guide plus quarter-to-date recovery commentary bought +14.2%. Nov 2025: a guide cut to 3-4% sold -2.6% (it fell 10% after hours first).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. RBC and Wolfe called the guide conservative in August, and TD Cowen models 7% FY SRS (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/cava-stock-best-day-5-months-wall-street-turn-bullish-cyclospora-recovery/cZo84clRJW4). The stock still fell about 26% after the August print to about $51.5. If a raised low end were fully priced, the downside skew would not sit at +16.5 and the late-October target cuts (Mizuho, KeyBanc, UBS, Citi, TD Cowen) would not have happened.
findings.independence: Q4-2025 SRS of +0.5% (the Q4 lap) is from a separate source: https://www.tikr.com/blog/cava-nyse-stock-surges-24-after-upbeat-earnings-and-strong-2026-outlook. The CFO's 'nothing suggests the low end' quote is from https://www.tikr.com/blog/the-cyclospora-scare-cost-cava-sales-in-july-august-erased-the-doubt (same call).

findings.finding: Chipotle's Q3 2026 8-K/10-Q (filed 2026-10-28, after CAVA last spoke) puts the summer food-safety hit to fast casual at low single digits. The headwind began in July, worsened for several weeks, and was gone by the end of August, when comp trends returned to pre-disruption levels. CMG's Q3 comp was +2.1% against +2.2% in Q2, and its two-year stack improved. This points to CAVA's Cyclospora dip being confined to roughly the first third of its Q3 (about mid-July to early October), which supports Q3 SRS at or slightly above the ~3-3.6% consensus.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. CAVA rose about 6.3% intraday on 2026-10-28 (https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/10/28/cava-group-cava-expected-to-announce-quarterly-earnings-on-wednesday.html) and +17% over 5 days. What is left is the transmission to CAVA. Its exposure (bowls and salads, lettuce headlines) was more direct than Chipotle's, so the dip may have been deeper or longer, and consensus SRS of ~3-3.6% may not have moved up after the CMG print (revenue estimates were flat over the week).
findings.independence: This is a proxy, a peer's print, not CAVA's number. It agrees with CAVA's own Aug 11 call: flat at the trough, then improving each week to mid-single digits (RBC/KeyBanc via https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/cava-stock-best-day-5-months-wall-street-turn-bullish-cyclospora-recovery/cZo84clRJW4).

findings.finding: Restaurant-level margin pressure into Q3/Q4 with an EBITDA guide to defend. The Q2 restaurant-level margin was 25.7%, down 60bp YoY, with about 100bp of salmon headwind. Management flagged further pressure from fuel surcharges and pre-marinated chicken, plus a seasonal Q4 drop of about 300bp. Q3 also carries deleverage from the weeks of flat SRS during Cyclospora. H1 adjusted EBITDA was $116.4m ($61.7m + $54.7m), so H2 needs $64.6-74.6m to meet the $181-191m guide. A trim to the margin or EBITDA range is the main downside path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2026: margin down 60bp YoY did not stop a +14.2% reaction because SRS dominated. Margin-led prints have not driven this name; SRS has.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly inside what management already guided: the fuel, chicken and seasonal Q4 drop were stated on the Aug call, so they are expected. The Cyclospora deleverage was not quantified by the company. Analysts cut targets after Q2 citing these costs (https://www.tikr.com/blog/why-is-cava-spending-100-million-to-buy-back-its-own-stock), so some of it is in estimates. A fully priced EBITDA trim would show up as consensus EPS cut below $0.12; it sits flat with a year ago.
findings.independence: Chipotle Q3 restaurant-level costs show labour deleverage (labour 25.7% vs 25.2%) on a ~2% comp (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001058090/000105809026000104/cmg-20260930.htm). That is a proxy. The H1 EBITDA figures come from the company releases (Q1 via https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/cava-raises-2026-outlook-strong-132300538.html, Q2 via the SEC 8-K).

findings.finding: CAVA's first buyback, $100m authorized 2026-09-17 (8-K, through Sept 2027), was announced with the stock about $52. Insiders also bought: the COO 6,500 shares at $66.52 on Aug 31 and the CLO 1,000 shares at $49.96 in September. Any Q3 repurchases at about $50-52 (Q3 ended about early October) and an update on usage will show up in the release. Cash was $322.8m with no debt, and FCF reached $29.3m in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior buyback on this name. The authorization day moved the stock only about +1.6% premarket (RTTNews via search snippet).
findings.why_not_priced: The authorization is public; how much was executed is not. If the market expected heavy use, the late-October target cuts would cite it. About 1.7% of shares is small, so this is a support signal, not a driver.
findings.independence: The insider buys are a separate source: https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/10/28/cava-group-cava-expected-to-announce-quarterly-earnings-on-wednesday.html (COO) and https://www.tikr.com/blog/why-is-cava-spending-100-million-to-buy-back-its-own-stock (CLO).

findings.finding: The bar was lowered into the print. In late October, Mizuho, KeyBanc ($95 to $80, 2026-10-23), UBS, Citi and TD Cowen cut price targets, mostly keeping Buy ratings. UBS described expectations as held 'with lower confidence', and revenue estimates fell 0.33% over 60 days. SRS consensus is about 3-3.6%, below the mid-single-digit recovery rate the CFO cited in August. Melius upgraded to Buy on 2026-10-08 ($95 target).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Into Aug 2026 targets were also being cut, and the print bought +14.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Estimate cuts set a lower SRS bar. The +17% 5-day run-up has since raised the bar the price holds, so most of this is offset. Small.
findings.independence: The KeyBanc cut and the analyst tally are from a separate source: https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/10/28/cava-group-cava-expected-to-announce-quarterly-earnings-on-wednesday.html. The Melius upgrade: https://www.tikr.com/blog/cava-group-has-lost-37-in-6-months-melius-sees-82-upside

findings.finding: Placer.ai's August 2026 data showed US restaurant visits down 2.4% YoY. CAVA fell 8.9% in one session on it, with WING -12.1% and CMG -5.9%. Labor Day fell on Sept 7 this year against Sept 1 in 2025, which shifts holiday dining into September. This is a negative traffic proxy inside CAVA's Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SRS misses: Q3 2025 1.9% vs 2.6-2.8% sold -2.6% close to close.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (exact date not on page; stock about $50)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock took an 8.9% one-day hit on it. It is an industry-wide visit count, and Chipotle's later company-level Q3 print (recovered by end of August) is a broader and more direct series, so this is sized below it.
findings.independence: Cuts against Chipotle's 10-Q recovery statement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001058090/000105809026000104/cmg-20260930.htm), which is the stronger source.

findings.finding: Sweetgreen, the closest salad/bowl peer, reported Q2 2026 SRS of -6.2% on 2026-08-07 and cut FY26 SRS guidance to -7% to -8%, linking the cut to weaker demand from Cyclospora fears. This suggests the leafy-greens scare hit the salad-heavy fast-casual category harder and longer than Chipotle's experience, and puts CAVA's Q3 SRS at risk of landing below the 'mid-single-digit' recovery rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: See the SRS line above; SRS against the bar has driven every large reaction on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since early August, before CAVA's Aug 11 call, so CAVA's own 'recovering to mid-single digits' commentary already postdates it. It is a proxy for a structurally weaker peer; I could not find Sweetgreen's Q3 2026 release.
findings.independence: Same Cyclospora event as the Chipotle finding but the opposite read. Chipotle is the later, primary document and points to recovery. Proxy only.
